content.text: I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 tests). The binary-operator branch (ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV, MOD, EQ, LT, GT) popped its operands in the wrong order. It used `a, b = pop(), pop()`, which made `a` the top of the stack, so every non-commutative operation ran with its operands swapped. That caused the wrong `LT` result and the `DIV`/`MOD` zero-division check testing the wrong operand. It also made the countdown loop's `SUB` count the wrong way, so the loop never ended and hit the step limit. I changed it to `b, a = pop(), pop()`. I didn't touch anything under `tests/`.

It also made the countdown loop's `SUB` count the wrong way, so the loop never ended and hit the step limit. I changed it to `b, a = pop(), pop()`. I didn't touch anything under `tests/`.
